state: Ticket annotation: a technician at a laboratory reported a fault, saying that the laboratory network access to internal systems was slow, and the gateway latency measured 180 milliseconds. Investigation found that the port rate-limit template of the access switch on the floor was configured incorrectly; the rate limit had been written as 10 Mbps instead of 100 Mbps. This problem can be fixed by changing the template back on the network management system and takes effect remotely; no need to enter the laboratory. Involves 30 ports and 30 subscribers, service degraded but not interrupted, ordinary customer. Note: the {order_no} capacity expansion applied for by the laboratory last week has not arrived yet; do not handle it together with this ticket. Score: impact scope 1 point + degradation 1 point + ordinary 0 points = 2 points; 0-1 routine, 2-3 standard, 4-5 urgent, 6 and above critical, it is standard.
